annotations.title: Search the WA (DMIRS DASC) data library

description: Use to find a Western Australian open-file dataset from the DMIRS Data and Software Centre (DASC) by its title: about 600 datasets (geology, geophysics compilations, mineralisation, WAROX field data, heritage, land, infrastructure, ...) and the 1:250 000 / 1:100 000 geological map sheets. Every word of q must appear in the title or category. Returns each dataset's title, group, category, last update, feature count and layer ids ("lib:...") for get_wa_library_features, query_features and make_map_link.
name: search_wa_data_library
title: Search the WA (DMIRS DASC) data library
